Division II Coaches Poll

Share this page

WBCA NCAA Division II Coaches’ Poll — 11/17/2026

The WBCA NCAA Division II Top 25 women’s basketball coaches’ poll, WITH TEAMS’ RECORDS THROUGH SUNDAY in parentheses, total points based on 25 for first place through one point for 25th, ranking in the preseason poll, and first-place votes received.

Printable Version PDF

Dropped out: No. 7 Minnesota State Mankato (1-3); No. 14 Central Missouri (3-3); No. 15t Daeman (2-1); No. 17 Glenville State (0-2); No. 24 Texas-Tyler (3-2); No. 25 Missouri-St. Louis (1-2).

Others receiving votes: Ferris State (1-0) 56; Colorado-Colorado Springs (2-0) 40; Augusta (3-0) 38; Daemen (2-1) 38; California State L.A. (2-0) 36; Miles (0-0) 35; Minnesota State Mankato (1-3) 29; Mary (3-0) 21; Lane (1-0) 15; Lincoln Memorial (2-1) 14; Texas-Tyler (3-2) 12; Virginia State (3-0) 10; Florida Southern (1-1) 7; Missouri Southern State (2-1) 7; Southern Connecticut State (2-0) 7; Benedict (0-0) 3.

12 teams mentioned on only one ballot for a total of 58 combined points.

The WBCA NCAA Division II Coaches Poll Committee is composed of one head coach from each of the 23 NCAA Division II conferences. The committee for the 2026-27 season: Mario Caetano, MSU Denver; Bill Cleary, St. Thomas Aquinas; Kevin Clifford, Roberts Wesleyan; Kyle Cooper, West Liberty; Carmen Dolfo, Western Washington; Steve Fagan, Felician; Darin Grover, Southeastern Oklahoma; Sarah Hopkins-Chery, Cal State Monterey Bay; Matt Houser, Columbus State; Tom Jessee, Tampa; Beth Jillson, Texas Woman’s; Tim LaKose, Dominican; Kim Lusk, Belmont Abbey; Mike Mincey, Carson-Newman; Kerry Phayre, Assumption; Ashlee Phillips, Auburn Montgomery; Kari Pickens, Ashland; Jenny Pruett, Saginaw Valley State; James Rice, Benedict; Jess Strom, California University (Pa.); Ebony Tanner, Shaw; Katie Vaughn, Missouri-St. Louis; Tom Webb, Southwest Minnesota State; Lora Westling, Washburn.
